scenes.headline: How a small model learns to rewrite science papers
scenes.sub: Frontier teachers, a small student, and a judge.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Torte! Here's how small open models learned to rewrite research papers for a fourteen-year-old.

scenes.text: Let a frontier model do the task well a few thousand times, then train a small model to copy it.
scenes.mark: train a small model to copy it
scenes.say: Let a big model do the task well a few thousand times. Then train a small model to copy it.

items.say: Pick one clear task: rewrite the whole paper, keeping every number.
Write a rubric a strong model can apply.
Refine the teacher's prompt, because the student copies its mistakes too.
Have the teachers rewrite a few thousand open papers.
Train one pass, and pick checkpoints by rubric, not loss.

steps.say: The first call reads the whole paper and rewrites the opening parts.
Then each section is rewritten on its own, given that opening.
Every call also gets a glossary of technical terms from an offline Wikipedia.
Out comes one plain rewrite of the same paper.

scenes.title: Two ways to train the student

left.title: The 4B student
items: A rank 32 LoRA, merged back in
left.say: The smaller student trained a low-rank adapter on a home graphics card.

right.title: The 9B student
right.say: The larger one trained every weight on one rented data-centre card.

scenes.title: The judge flattened before the loss did

steps.say: But a checkpoint a third of the way in scored as well as the final one.

scenes.title: Nine B against Terra, by judge
scenes.say: The catch. With Opus judging, the nine B student beats Terra eleven to four. With Astra judging, Terra wins fifteen to nothing.

scenes.label: for the teacher rewrites at list prices, against about $80 of training
scenes.say: And the GPU is the cheap part. Teacher rewrites cost about forty-six hundred dollars at list prices.

scenes.text: A student copies its teacher's style first and its facts last, so judge it with more than the teacher's family.
scenes.say: Students copy style first and facts last. Judge them with more than the teacher's family.

recap: Frontier teachers write, a small student copies
scenes.say: Teachers write, students copy, the rubric picks the checkpoint, and a second judge keeps it honest.
